verdict.rationale: Xero has a documented, open-format API (OpenAPI descriptions repo, developer.xero.com docs, xero-node SDK) and the SDK description explicitly references access to 'general ledger accounting data,' supporting the core capability. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms a Trial Balance report endpoint or shows end-to-end extraction of the full GL/TB, so full delivery isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of a Trial Balance report endpoint, independent developer confirmation of pulling full GL/TB data, and export format details (JSON/CSV) for these specific reports.
